summary: This study is testing how a diabetes drug called dapagliflozin affects plaque buildup in the heart arteries of people with type 2 diabetes and coronary artery disease. Participants are divided into two groups to receive either the study drug plus standard care or standard care alone for 18 months. The trial is currently Recruiting and aims to include 144 participants. Junjie Yang is the sponsor for this Phase 4 clinical trial.
